entities.name: Wirewood Forest
entities.description: Open, airy forest in southern Otaria bordering the Skirk Ridge; home to Otaria's only elves, now a living cage.

entities.name: Wirewood elves
entities.description: Elves who migrated to Wirewood after the Phyrexian Invasion and mutated into green-skinned plant creatures.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Influence mutated the elves and the forest.

events.summary: Under the influence of the Mirari, many Wirewood elves mutate into green-skinned plant creatures and the forest becomes a living cage.
events.quote: many of the elves mutated into green-skinned plant creatures

relations.quote: Located in the continent's southern reaches
